en_US.title: Contract Continuity Desk Signatures
en_US.scanner: The contract trap is assembled from clause fragments, not one villain order.
en_US.field_note: Use lower signatures as stamps of procedure: lien merge, oxygen addendum, blacklist risk and payload hold.
en_US.terminal: SIGNATURE SEED: Edda Malk, Contract Continuity Desk. Function: merges Aegir Reclamation Pool lien terms with Black Keel recovery clauses. Not a mastermind.
en_US.audio: Nobody says trap. They say continuity.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Contract Continuity Desk signatures let mission text show how a salvage job becomes legal pressure without inventing a new villain.
en_US.external_site: Contract Continuity Desk Signatures defines the lower Deep Reach paperwork surface behind the opening contract.

ru_RU.title: Подписи Contract Continuity Desk

ru_RU.field_note: Нижние подписи работают как следы процедуры: слияние долга, кислородное приложение, риск blacklist и payload hold.
ru_RU.terminal: SIGNATURE SEED: Edda Malk, Contract Continuity Desk. Функция: сшивает условия Aegir Reclamation Pool с Black Keel recovery clauses. Не mastermind.
ru_RU.audio: Никто не пишет ловушка. Пишут continuity.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Подписи Contract Continuity Desk показывают, как salvage job превращается в юридическое давление без нового главного злодея.

en_US.title: Packet Notary Interface Signatures
en_US.scanner: A packet seal can protect truth or bury it under custody delay.
en_US.field_note: The notary surface is useful because it names relay time, hash witness and custody owner in one place.
en_US.terminal: SIGNATURE SEED: Som Varela, Packet Notary Interface. Function: seals packet hashes, relay delay and custody status. Treat as evidence routing, not motive.
en_US.audio: A seal is not mercy. It is a clock with a price.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Packet Notary Interface signatures explain why some logs matter only after the player proves route, time and witness hash.
en_US.external_site: Packet Notary Interface Signatures turns interstellar delay into a legal evidence system for HECTON-8.

ru_RU.title: Подписи Packet Notary Interface
ru_RU.scanner: Пакетная печать может защитить правду или похоронить ее под custody delay.
ru_RU.field_note: Нотариальная поверхность ценна тем, что в одном месте дает relay time, witness hash и custody owner.
ru_RU.terminal: SIGNATURE SEED: Som Varela, Packet Notary Interface. Функция: заверяет packet hashes, relay delay и custody status. Это маршрутизация доказательства, не мотив.
ru_RU.audio: Печать не милосердие. Это часы с ценой.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Подписи Packet Notary Interface объясняют, почему часть логов важна только после доказательства маршрута, времени и witness hash.
ru_RU.external_site: Подписи Packet Notary Interface превращают межзвездную задержку в юридическую систему доказательств HECTON-8.
